headline: Typhoon Surigae nears Japan's Daito Islands, forecast to approach Izu Islands and Kanto by Thursday

supports: Typhoon Surigae (Typhoon No. 26) was located near Japan's Daito Islands and tracking northeast on September 28, 2026.
The storm was forecast to approach the Izu Islands south of Tokyo by Thursday, October 1, with a possible track toward Shizuoka Prefecture and the Kanto region.
As of 3 p.m. on September 28, Surigae had a central pressure of 955 hectopascals, maximum sustained winds of 45 meters per second, and gusts of 65 meters per second.
